gloss: to extinguish (a fire); to put out a fire

definitions.gloss: to extinguish a fire; to put out a fire; to fight a fire
definitions.explanation: To stop a fire from burning by applying water, chemicals, or other means.

examples.japanese: ⟦{消防士|しょうぼうし}→消防士：05057_shouboushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{消火|しょうか}した。
⟦{初期|しょき}→初期：11742_shoki⟧⟦{消火|しょうか}→消火：13291_shouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that early firefighting is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧30{分|ぷん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{消火|しょうか}された。
examples.english: The fire was extinguished about 30 minutes after the call was made.

notes:
{消火|しょうか}する combines {消|しょう} (extinguish) and {火|か} (fire). It is the standard technical term for firefighting and fire extinguishment. The noun ⟦{消火|しょうか}→消火：13291_shouka⟧ appears in many compound terms related to fire safety.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{消火|しょうか}{器|き}→消火器：15332_shoukaki⟧: fire extinguisher
- ⟦{消火|しょうか}{栓|せん}→消火栓：29794_shoukasen⟧: fire hydrant
- ⟦{消火|しょうか}→消火：13291_shouka⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: firefighting operations
- ⟦{初期|しょき}→初期：11742_shoki⟧⟦{消火|しょうか}→消火：13291_shouka⟧: initial firefighting (putting out a fire before it spreads)
- ⟦{消火|しょうか}→消火：13291_shouka⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧: firefighting drill

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to put out a fire — everyday expression using native Japanese words
- ⟦{鎮火|ちんか}する→鎮火する：22509_chinkasuru⟧: to be extinguished; to die down — describes the fire being brought under control, often used in news reports for the result
- ⟦{防火|ぼうか}→防火：21169_bouka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prevent fire — focuses on prevention rather than extinguishing
